name: Maharaja Temple
town_description: Arrah (officially Ara) is the headquarters of Bhojpur district in western Bihar, near the Son river. It is famed as the home of 1857-revolt hero Veer Kunwar Singh, and its name derives from goddess Aranya Devi.

travel.airport: Nearest commercial airport: Patna (Jay Prakash Narayan International, PAT), about 55-60 km by road.
travel.railway: Ara Junction, on the Patna-Mughalsarai main line, lies within the city.
travel.road: Connected to Patna via NH 30/NH 922 (Veer Kunwar Singh Setu over the Son); regular bus and taxi services.
